## VIX (Volatility Index) term structure

The data is downloaded from the [Taiwan Futures Exchange](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/3/dlOptDailyMarketView). VIX for each expiration date is calculated, and a daily static term-structure chart is published. The methodology is based on Cboe VIX, see [Cboe Volatility Index Mathematics Methodology](https://cdn.cboe.com/resources/indices/Cboe_Volatility_Index_Mathematics_Methodology.pdf).

## IV (Implied Volatility) Calibration

IV is calculated by numerically inverting the Black formula for each eligible OTM option quote. The workflow uses settlement prices, requires exact option–futures expiration matching, and performs no nearest-contract substitution or IV smoothing.

### TAIEX Futures (TXF) IV calibration

Only TXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying the four nearest expiration dates.

### Mini-TAIEX Futures (MXF) IV calibration

Only MXF futures contracts with matching expiration dates are included. The chart updates daily, displaying the four nearest expiration dates.

  <p id="mtx-status">Loading the latest MXF calibration chart…</p>

</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const user = "siang-dai";
  const repo = "txo-vix-term-structure";
  const stamp = Date.now();
  const rawBase = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${user}/${repo}/main/output`;

  const setChart = (imageId, statusId, filename) => {
    const image = document.getElementById(imageId);
    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    image.src = `${rawBase}/${filename}?t=${stamp}`;
    image.onerror = () => {
      status.textContent = "The chart is not available yet. Run the repository workflow once.";
    };
  };

  setChart("vix-chart", "vix-status", "latest_term_structure.png");
  setChart("tx-chart", "tx-status", "latest_tx_iv_calibration.png");
  setChart("mtx-chart", "mtx-status", "latest_mtx_iv_calibration.png");

  fetch(`${rawBase}/latest.json?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("VIX metadata unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(meta => {
      document.getElementById("vix-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} || Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      document.getElementById("vix-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated VIX-style chart.";
    });

  fetch(`${rawBase}/latest_iv.json?t=${stamp}`)
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("IV metadata unavailable");
      return response.json();
    })
    .then(meta => {
      const tx = meta.products.TX;
      const mtx = meta.products.MTX;
      document.getElementById("tx-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} || ${tx.plotted_points} OTM IV points || Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
      document.getElementById("mtx-status").textContent =
        `Latest trading date: ${meta.as_of_date} || ${mtx.plotted_points} OTM IV points || Generated in Taiwan: ${meta.generated_at_taipei}`;
    })
    .catch(() => {
      document.getElementById("tx-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated TX IV calibration chart.";
      document.getElementById("mtx-status").textContent = "Latest automatically generated MTX IV calibration chart.";
    });
})();
</script>

For detailed contract specifications and expiration dates, please refer to the [TAIFEX Futures Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tX) and [TAIFEX Options Specs](https://www.taifex.com.tw/cht/2/tXO).
